Blue Heart Energy  Electronics Technician Help build and test the electronics behind our innovative heat pump technology, from prototypes to production.  Job description About BlueHeart Energy Founded in 2016, BlueHeart Energy set out to solve one of the biggest challenges in energy: creating heating and cooling systems that are efficient, affordable, and sustainable. After nearly a decade of research and development, we introduced the BlueHeart engine: a breakthrough thermoacoustic technology designed to deliver high performance with minimal energy use and zero carbon emissions across residential and industrial applications. Our work is driven by innovation, precision engineering, and a commitment to redefining heating and cooling for a sustainable world. About The Role As our Electronics Technician, you will play a hands-on role in building, modifying, testing, and troubleshooting the electronic systems that power our thermoacoustic heat pump technology. Working closely with our hardware and test engineers, you will assemble and repair electronic control boxes, wiring harnesses, PCBAs, and electrical subassemblies, ensuring every component meets our quality and safety standards. With our first prototype in production, you will join at an exciting stage where your technical skills and attention to detail will directly contribute to prototype development, product reliability, and the transition towards scalable manufacturing.
